description: Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition no.2 (approved plans) seeking adjustments to the approved design, in pursuant to planning permission reference 204654FUL dated  25/05/2022 for: Redevelopment of land at the rear of Nos 11 to 15 The Mall to provide a 9 storey building with basement, comprising 34 self-contained flats , (following part demolition of the existing extensions and structures to the rear of Nos. 11 to 15); Proposed E(b) Use (Restaurant) at basement; Existing E(b) Restaurant Use at ground floor of No. 13 The Mall to be extended into the rear of No. 12, change of use of ground floor of No. 12 The Mall from Retail to Residential (to form Entrance Lobby to Flats), to include alteration to front facade; alterations to existing air extract plant at Nos. 11, 12 and 13; bicycle, refuse and recycling stores (Part Retrospective).
